```sql
SELECT id
FROM orders
ORDER BY order_date ASC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 99;
```
这个查询将按`order_date`对`orders`表进行排序，并返回第100个订单的ID。

```sql
SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_name;
```
